🔴 高危 问题1 — 登记发货存在并发超发（TOCTOU），可突破剩余可发上限
文件：backend/app/routers/sales_orders.py　位置：约第 168 行
问题描述：register_sales_order_shipment 先读取 order.shipped_qty 计算 remaining，再校验 body.ship_qty > remaining，最后 order.shipped_qty += body.ship_qty 并 commit。整个「读-判-写」不在同一临界区，也无行级锁/乐观锁/条件更新。触发条件：两个请求（或双击提交、脚本并发）同时以剩余可发=10 的订单各提交 ship_qty=10，两个请求都读到 shipped_qty=0、remaining=10，均通过校验，最终 shipped_qty=20 > plan_qty=10，直接违反 R04「超发拒绝」验收项，且 ShipmentRecord 落两条各 10 的记录，数据不可信。属 CWE-362 竞态 / CWE-667 不当加锁，OWASP A04 不安全设计。
// ❌ 当前代码
```
remaining = max(0, order.plan_qty - order.shipped_qty)
    if body.ship_qty > remaining:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"登记发货数量不能超过剩余可发（{remaining}）",
        )

```
修改建议：把「校验+累加」收敛为数据库层的原子条件更新：用带 WHERE shipped_qty + :qty <= plan_qty 的 UPDATE，依据 rowcount 判断是否成功，成功后再插入 ShipmentRecord，同一事务提交。或对订单行加 SELECT ... FOR UPDATE（SQLite 下用 BEGIN IMMEDIATE / 唯一约束兜底）。验证：写并发脚本（threading + 两个 HTTP 请求）对同一订单同时提交剩余可发数量，修复前两条都返回 200 且 shipped_qty 翻倍；修复后仅一条 200、另一条 400「不能超过剩余可发」，且 shipped_qty 恒 <= plan_qty。
// ✅ 正确做法
```
from sqlalchemy import update

@router.post("/{order_id}/register-shipment", response_model=SalesOrderItem)
def register_sales_order_shipment(
    order_id: int,
    body: RegisterShipmentBody,
    _current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
):
    # 原子条件更新：只有 shipped_qty + qty <= plan_qty 时才生效
    result = db.execute(
        update(SalesOrder)
        .where(
            SalesOrder.id == order_id,
            SalesOrder.status != "closed",
            SalesOrder.shipped_qty + body.ship_qty <= SalesOrder.plan_qty,
        )
        .values(shipped_qty=SalesOrder.shipped_qty + body.ship_qty)
    )
    if result.rowcount == 0:
        order = db.query(SalesOrder).filter(SalesOrder.id == order_id).first()
        if order is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="销售订单不存在")
        if order.status == "closed":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="订单已关单，无法继续登记发货")
        remaining = max(0, order.plan_qty - order.shipped_qty)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"登记发货数量不能超过剩余可发（{remaining}）",
        )

    order = db.query(SalesOrder).filter(SalesOrder.id == order_id).first()
    if order.shipped_qty >= order.plan_qty:
        order.status = "closed"

    shipped_at = body.shipped_at or datetime.utcnow()
    record = ShipmentRecord(
        sales_order_id=order.id, ship_qty=body.ship_qty, shipped_at=shipped_at
    )
    db.add(record)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)
    db.refresh(record)
    return _order_item(order, record)
```

def _generate_order_no(db: Session) -> str:
    year = date.today().year
    prefix = f"SO-{year}-"
    rows = (
        db.query(SalesOrder.order_no)
        .filter(SalesOrder.order_no.like(f"{prefix}%"))

from sqlalchemy import update
from fastapi import HTTPException
from app.models import SalesOrder, ShipmentRecord

def register_shipment(db, order_id: int, ship_qty: int, shipped_at):
    result = db.execute(
        update(SalesOrder)
        .where(
            SalesOrder.id == order_id,
            SalesOrder.status != "closed",
            SalesOrder.shipped_qty + ship_qty <= SalesOrder.plan_qty,
        )
        .values(shipped_qty=SalesOrder.shipped_qty + ship_qty)
    )
    if result.rowcount == 0:
        order = db.query(SalesOrder).filter(SalesOrder.id == order_id).first()
        if order is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="销售订单不存在")
        if order.status == "closed":
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="订单已关单，无法继续登记发货")
        remaining = max(0, order.plan_qty - order.shipped_qty)
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=f"登记发货数量不能超过剩余可发（{remaining}）")
    order = db.query(SalesOrder).filter(SalesOrder.id == order_id).first()
    if order.shipped_qty >= order.plan_qty:
        order.status = "closed"
    record = ShipmentRecord(sales_order_id=order.id, ship_qty=ship_qty, shipped_at=shipped_at)
    db.add(record)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(order)
    db.refresh(record)
    return order, record
